pr_title: sql: fix crdb_internal.zones(target) to show user-defined schemas
pr_body:
fixes #61728 

This also includes a 2nd commit that adds a schema_name column to
crdb_internal.zones.

Release note (bug fix): Previously the `target` column of
crdb_internal.zones would show names without properly accounting for
user-defined schemas. Now it does.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/61898)

issue_context.title: sql: crdb_internal.zones incorrectly assumes all tables are in the public schema
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

The zone configs in crdb_internal.zones do not distinguish between tables in different schemas. It assumes everything is in the `public` schema.

**To Reproduce**
```
root@:26257/defaultdb> create schema s;
CREATE SCHEMA

root@:26257/defaultdb> create table s.t(a int primary key);
CREATE TABLE

root@:26257/defaultdb> ALTER TABLE s.t CONFIGURE ZONE USING range_min_bytes = 0, range_max_bytes = 90000, gc.ttlseconds = 89999, num_replicas = 1;
CONFIGURE ZONE 1

root@:26257/defaultdb> select target, database_name, table_name, raw_config_yaml from crdb_internal.zones where table_name = 't';;
           target          | database_name | table_name |    raw_config_yaml
---------------------------+---------------+------------+-------------------------
  TABLE defaultdb.public.t | defaultdb     | t          | range_min_bytes: 0
                           |               |            | range_max_bytes: 90000
                           |               |            | gc:
                           |               |            |   ttlseconds: 89999
                           |               |            | global_reads: null
                           |               |            | num_replicas: 1
                           |               |            | num_voters: null
                           |               |            | constraints: []
                           |               |            | voter_constraints: []
                           |               |            | lease_preferences: []
```


**Expected behavior**

Add a schema_name column, and make sure the existing target column shows the correct schema.
